CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_filtered_store_sales AS
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id, item.i_brand, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN store_sales ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id;

CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_date_item ON store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk);

SELECT * FROM mv_filtered_store_sales
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, i_brand_id
LIMIT 100
